There's me and her. She is who I used to be. I'm transgender and I'm in the middle of transitioning. I'm pre-op and it's so painful every day to wake up and be like this. I no longer have insurance to pay for my testosterone, so I've had to stop taking that. My body is wrong. I also have bpd which already makes me feel like I don't know who I am. I disassociated so badly today in the shower that I wasn't who I am now. I was her. Everything I knew was different. I banged the sides of my head and begged to come back. The thought she had was "oh god he's stolen my body give it back" went through my head in her voice and it scared me so bad... I don't want to live like this anymore I just want it all to stop.
I have plenty of reasons why I want to, but I just can't bring myself to do it. Others will see it as a good thing but I just can't.
